pool.text: Macau was placed under the jurisdiction of the new Xiangshan County.
Thousands of refugees fleeing the Mongol conquest settled in the coastal area.
Explorer Jorge Álvares became the first European visitor to reach China by sea.
Luso-Canton trade relations were formally reestablished after peaceful negotiations.
Portugal acquired a permanent lease for Macau as a trading post.
The Roman Catholic Diocese of Macau was created.
The Kuomintang further affirmed Portuguese jurisdiction during treaty renegotiations.
Japan installed government advisors after capturing a British cargo ship.
The United States paid financial compensation to Portugal for war damage.
Casino gambling was legalised under a government-licensed monopoly.
Dissatisfied residents rioted during the peak of the Cultural Revolution.
Portugal and China signed the Joint Declaration on the Question of Macau.
The territory was handed over to China after centuries of Portuguese rule.
Municipalities were abolished and superseded by the Civic and Municipal Affairs Bureau.
Downtown architecture resulted in designation as a World Heritage Site.
The Chief Executive was invited to request Associate Observer status for Macau.
Residents wrote a letter to UNESCO complaining about nearby construction projects.
An association submitted a report claiming failure to protect cultural heritage.
The government approved a construction height limit contrary to regulations.
A Western-style medical school was opened by the local university.
